# Lee Sagi Photography

> Photographs by Lee Sagi. Based in the East Bay, California. Shoots on a Nikon D7500. Mostly black and white, street.

I photograph what I run into. Backcountry tracks and desert camps, the streets near home, people I know, and more. No rime or reason, just photos I like.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/btbw666/
Threads: https://www.threads.com/@btbw666
YouTube (Overland Out & About): https://www.youtube.com/@OverlandOutAndAbout
Contact: harbor.lens.studio@gmail.com

## Collections

- [The Streets](https://leesagi.com/albums/the-streets/): 11 photographs
- [Faces](https://leesagi.com/albums/faces/): 7 photographs
- [Birds](https://leesagi.com/albums/birds/): 5 photographs
- [Land & Sky](https://leesagi.com/albums/land-and-sky/): 10 photographs
- [Selected Work](https://leesagi.com/albums/misc/): 11 photographs

## Outings

- [Oakland Chinatown - Murals, Vendors and the Produce Market](https://leesagi.com/outings/oakland-chinatown-murals-vendors-produce-market/) (2026-10-26): A Monday morning in Oakland Chinatown, 8 to 10 a.m., with low, hard sun cutting across the murals and the produce stands.
- [Downtown San Mateo - Crosswalks on a Gray Morning](https://leesagi.com/outings/downtown-san-mateo-gray-morning/) (2026-10-21): A Wednesday morning downtown with the 35mm and a flat gray sky: no light to work with, only people and timing.
